name: 65/35 reference
description: The reference weights a target is held to by subset: each named subset's total target weight stays within its tolerance of the subset's total here. `band` is the rebalance band: the maximum deviation from its target, as a fraction of the portfolio's value, that any targeted position may land at after a rebalance. The person's number; a unit never writes this file, so no unit can widen the band it is checked against.
